Fault: in cli/src/commands/notebook/notebookRecovery.ts, replace body.liveTree with acceptedHead. Keep the existing real-Git pending/staged/unstaged/untracked fixture and assertion unchanged. The CLI run boundary reaches NotebookController.recoverNotebookGit once with A in place of L; cli/tests/notebookRecovery.test.ts:53 rejects that exact outgoing body. A later harness expected a matcher method name in the failure text; inspection confirmed the real assertion at line53 instead. These harness errors were not product failures or extra baseline/fault retries. Raw JSON/logs are retained outside Git in /Users/terryyin/.codex/tmp/seed121-intent-evidence.
